festivals: Poochoriyal flower festival (Tamil month Masi, 28 days)

history.dynasty: 18th century; built by King Vijayaraya Chakravarthi (per livechennai.com)
history.period: 18th century; earlier history murky (some sites claim 700-2000 years)
history.summary: One of Tamil Nadu's most famous and wealthiest Mariamman temples, second only to Palani in revenue. The moolavar Samayapurathal is made of sand and clay, so no abhishekam is performed on the main deity. The goddess famously undertakes a 28-day fast for the welfare of humanity from the last Sunday of Maasi, eating only fruits and flour, ending with the Poo Choriyal (flower-bath) festival. Devotees offer small metal replicas of afflicted body parts seeking cures, and women donate mangalyams to the hundi. Historical name: Kannapuram. Tuesdays and Fridays draw the heaviest crowds. DUPLICATE FLAG: seq 2256 'Samayapuram Mariamman Temple, Tiruchirappalli' is the SAME temple — the 2256 record should carry a -duplicate id (e.g. samayapuram-mariamman-temple-duplicate). CSV TOWN FLAG: town corrected from Srirangam to Samayapuram (temple stands at Samayapuram on NH-45, ~11 km from Tiruchirappalli).

name: Samayapuram Mariamman Temple
town_description: Samayapuram is a small temple town on NH-45 (Trichy-Chennai highway) in Tiruchirappalli district, about 11 km north of Tiruchirappalli and 10 km from Srirangam. It exists around the Mariamman temple, one of the highest-revenue temples of Tamil Nadu, and fills with pilgrims during Thai Poosam and the Masi Poochoriyal festival.

travel.airport: Tiruchirappalli International Airport, about 20-22 km away.
travel.railway: Srirangam railway station, about 9.4 km away; Tiruchirappalli Junction further on.
travel.road: On NH-45 (Trichy-Chennai highway); frequent buses from Tiruchirappalli and Srirangam.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Masi (Feb-Mar) Poochoriyal and Thai Poosam are the grandest festivals; Tuesdays and Fridays are special days.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Most sources: 5:00 AM-11:00 AM and 4:00 PM-8:00 PM (verify: some list 5:30 AM-8:45 PM or 9:00 PM continuously).
